fact: On 18 June 2026 Trident said its in-country subsidiary Trident DRC develops and operates the RDC-PASS national digital identity platform under a 20-year public-private partnership with the Government, launched at a state ceremony in Kinshasa on 13 June 2026.
title: Trident Digital Tech Holdings (Nasdaq: TDTH) Activates National RDC-PASS Digital Identity Ecosystem in the Democratic Republic of Congo Under 20-Year Public-Private Partnership
